'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Thomas Nobe LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Nobe]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)|V25-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WAT2 This Thing's Bad
* '''Username:''' Brutstick?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
